# Unpack xz 
Simple wrapper for decompress xz archives by wasm.
Size 76KB. gzip\brotli\zstd ~ 31.2 KB

## Motivation
Wasm modules are poorly compressed by the algorithms available to the browser. Also, the zstd is not available in Safari, which prevents the use of large applications compiled in wasm

## usage

```javascript
    <script type="module">
        const DATA_BASE64_XZ = "";

        function base64ToUint8Array(base64) {
            const binaryString = atob(base64);
            const len = binaryString.length;
            const bytes = new Uint8Array(len);
            for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                bytes[i] = binaryString.charCodeAt(i);
            }
            return bytes;
        }

        import init, { decompress_xz } from './unpack_xz.js';

        async function run() {
            await init();
            const uint8Array = base64ToUint8Array(DATA_BASE64_XZ);
            const out = decompress_xz(uint8Array);
            const string = new TextDecoder().decode(out);
            console.log(string);
        }

        run();
    </script>
```
## Build
 - install wasm-pack by cargo `cargo install wasm-pack`

```shell
wasm-pack build --target web --release
```
